entities.name: Bulgarian Men's High School of Thessaloniki
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Sts. Cyril and Methodius Bulgarian Men's High School of Thessaloniki was the first Bulgarian high school in Macedonia. One of the most influential Bulgarian educational centres in Macedonia, it was founded in autumn 1880 in Ottoman Thessaloniki and existed until 1913.
